name: Huafu Fashion Co., Ltd.
summary: Huafu Fashion Co., Ltd. manufactures and supplies colored yarns in China and internationally. It offers middle and high-class color spun yarns, semi-worsted color yarns, vortex spun color yarns, melange yarns, rotor spun color yarns, high-class new-type grey yarns and dyed yarns. It also provides value-added services, such as fashion trends, certification of raw materials and products, hanging of tags, and technical consulting services. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
